omscs-which-specialization-should-you-ch.title: OMSCS: Which Specialization Should You Choose?
omscs-which-specialization-should-you-ch.summary: OSMCS: Which Specialization Should You Choose?  There are two schools of thought:  Get a degree as fast as you can (in which case, I suggest Interactive Intelligence) Learn something specialized (ML, Robotics, HCI, etc.)  Either way, there’s a general way you’ll want to go about this, which is, see which classes fulfill multiple specializations your interested in:  Classes that overlap  One thing you’ll want to make sure is, you don’t re-do too many class requirements from the specializations list:  The OMSCS specializations  Hey this is a nother title  And then some text, maybe a list  What is in a name Hey
